summary.intent: Review pending GSD todos, consolidate related items into Phase 48 (SDK self-bootstrap regression fix + shared-folder/metadata consolidation), plan the phase, and execute Wave 1 (the P0 fix for a web-e2e regression introduced by PR #498) — with the user AFK for most of execution.
summary.outcome: Phase 48 was created, researched, planned (6 plans across 3 waves), and Wave 1 execution began. The `loadFolder` sequence guard was implemented and greened one of two failing specs. The `bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts` spec remained red through 3 CI dispatches and multiple mis-aimed fixes; the session ended mid-investigation with the real root cause identified (BinPage auth-guard race in the CoreKit restore window) but the fix not yet verified.

repo: web-e2e only triggers on push to main (ci-e2e.yml), not on PRs — the gap that let PR #498 regress main undetected

web-e2e.yml has workflow_dispatch with a `ref` input; manual dispatch against any branch: `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh workflow run web-e2e.yml --ref <branch>` — no CI change needed, resolves repo secrets directly
`bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts` uses real Web3Auth Core Kit DEVNET (loginViaWallet), not the TEST_LOGIN_SECRET bypass — requires outbound internet and VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID; login takes ~90s

TypeORM is configured with `migrationsRun: true, synchronize: false` in app.module.ts — the API runs migrations automatically on boot against cipherbox_test; no manual migration step during e2e bring-up
Playwright webServer auto-starts mock-ipns (3001), API (3000), and web (5173); only the 3 Docker services + package builds + .env files need manual setup
Phase 47 covered owned-folder SDK consolidation (PR #494); Phase 48 is the shared-folder/metadata counterpart
The `sharedFolderTree` design decision: use a sibling Map keyed by shareId (not extend folderTree) because shared folders carry a distinct SharedWriteContext and can collide on ipnsName

The BinPage auth-guard race: `isLoading = !coreKitInitialized || isLoggingIn || isLoggingOut` has a window after coreKitInitialized flips true but before restoreSession sets isLoggingIn=true, where `!isLoading && !isAuthenticated` is briefly true — causing protected-route guards to redirect to '/'

code.finding: loadFolder did unconditional folderTree.set() — self-bootstrap clobbered fresher in-memory state with stale IPNS snapshot; fixed with sequenceNumber guard (keep existing if existing.sequenceNumber >= resolved)

loadBin auto-repair blind-published an empty bin record with no expectedSequenceNumber on transient IPNS 404, clobbering real bin data; API's upsertFolderIpns unconditionally increments+overwrites latestCid; fix: return in-memory empty BinState with seq 0 after bounded retry, never publish on read

isLoading definition missing coverage for the CoreKit restore window — after coreKitInitialized=true but before restoreSession sets isLoggingIn=true, all protected routes briefly see !isLoading && !isAuthenticated and redirect to '/'
Auth guard fires navigate('/') during the restore window gap; FilesPage survives because it mounts during loading, but BinPage mounts fresh on navigation after reload, landing in the gap

Catch block navigates to '/files' when a subfolder resolve fails — initially hypothesized as the bounce source, but [Nav] Failed to load subfolder never appeared in traces; this path was not the actual cause
ensureFolderLoaded short-circuit (:422) and DFS child-check (:454) must be kept intact when adding the sequenceNumber guard to avoid re-regressing #498
StrictMode is enabled — double-invokes effects in dev; CI also runs vite dev, so StrictMode races are real in the e2e environment

workflow: Pull Playwright failure artifacts (error-context.md + screenshot) as the first diagnostic for e2e failures, not after multiple fix attempts — the page snapshot immediately showed '/files' not '/bin', which would have redirected all investigation earlier
The Playwright trace (network + console timeline) is the highest-signal diagnostic: shows IPNS resolve counts, console logs order, and exact navigation sequence — pulled too late in this session

For the bin-restore spec: the trace showed 22 IPNS 404s, the auto-repair log firing, and the navigation sequence push('#/bin') → push('#/') → push('#/files') — sufficient to identify all root causes without code reading
When a long-running agent dies on stream timeout with uncommitted work: snapshot to patch immediately, review the diff before committing rather than blindly trusting 72 min of unverified changes
1Password SSH signing can wedge mid-unattended-run; have an explicit contingency (unsigned commits + flag for re-sign/admin-merge before landing) agreed in advance

The GSD branching strategy (phase mode) creates its own canonical branch name; when already on a feature branch, the strategy forks a new branch from HEAD — all prior commits are preserved but the branch name changes
Dispatching CI 3 times on hypothesis-driven fixes before pulling ground-truth artifacts is expensive; the Playwright trace was available after the first red dispatch

friction: 1Password SSH signing wedged mid-run (`failed to fill whole buffer`) during unattended execution, forcing unsigned commits from fe646fd5f onward
Three CI dispatches consumed on wrong hypotheses before the Playwright trace was pulled — trace should have been the first diagnostic
The 72-min local-repro agent died on stream idle timeout with all work uncommitted and uncommitted scope expansion beyond the planned fix

`bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts` had three incorrect root-cause hypotheses in sequence: (1) loadFolder clobber, (2) bin auto-repair on transient 404, (3) useFolderNavigation catch-block bounce — the real cause was the BinPage auth-guard race
Port 3000 conflict with an unrelated project (IRL Network) blocked local stack bring-up until the user authorized killing those processes
web-e2e uses real Web3Auth DEVNET (not test-login bypass), making each local spec run ~4–5 min with network dependency — slow iteration loop for debugging

The GSD branching strategy created `feat/sdk-self-bootstrap-regression-fix-and-shared-folder-metadata` mid-session alongside the manually-created `feat/phase-48-sdk-self-bootstrap-fix-and-shares`, briefly creating ambiguity about the canonical branch
